lines.zh: 阴影中悄无声息地移动着...
lines.en: Moving silently in the shadows...

lines.zh: 月光下它的身影更显诡谲...
lines.en: The moonlight makes it look more sinister...
Its step is as light as a feather...

lines.zh: 悄悄接近，别让玩家察觉...
lines.en: Creeping closer, don't let the player notice...
It moves freely in the night...
The rustling in the shadows...
It waits for the perfect moment...
It appears even darker in moonlight...
Moving quietly at night...
I slip along the reed shadows.

lines.zh: 泥水没过脚踝，我悄声走过。
lines.en: Mud to my ankles, I pass without a sound.

lines.zh: 我贴着芦苇边走，风没惊动。
lines.en: I slip along the reeds without stirring the wind.
Standing quietly in the shadows...
Its form appears and disappears...
Looking around quietly...
It's hard to notice its presence...
Guarding in the shadows...
Waiting quietly for an opportunity...
It seems to be waiting...
Watching the player quietly...
Hiding in the shadows...
Waiting quietly for the best moment...
Noted the player...
Looking towards the player...
Gradually turning towards the player...
Eyes fixed on the player...
Tailing the player quietly...
Tracking the player's movements...
Eyes full of malice...
Eyes betraying greed...
Approaching the player quietly...
Watching the player's hand...

lines.zh: 阿尔普低下了头，浑身湿漉漉的。
lines.en: Alp hunches over, drenched.

lines.zh: 阿尔普的翅膀在阳光下颤抖着。
lines.en: Alp shivers in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 阿尔普发出虚弱的尖叫。
lines.en: Alp lets out a weak cry.

lines.zh: 阿尔普的触手垂下，无力地摆动。
lines.en: Alp's tentacles droop weakly.

lines.zh: 阿尔普的体色黯淡无光。
lines.en: Alp's color fades.

lines.zh: 阿尔普的眼睛失去了光芒。
lines.en: Alp's eyes lose their shine.

lines.zh: 阿尔普的呼吸声越来越弱。
lines.en: Alp's breath grows weaker.

lines.zh: 阿尔普开始蜷缩成一团。
lines.en: Alp curls up into a ball.

lines.zh: 阿尔普的皮肤变得皱皱巴巴。
lines.en: Alp's skin wrinkles.

lines.zh: 阿尔普无力地倒在了地上。
lines.en: Alp collapses to the ground.

lines.zh: 你的一块面包让它现身了。
lines.en: A piece of bread drew it out.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着贪婪的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes gleamed with greed.

lines.zh: 你手中的火把引来它的注意。
lines.en: Its attention was caught by your torch.

lines.zh: 它的触角在黑暗中寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its触角在黑暗中寻找猎物. Its feelers searched in the darkness.

lines.zh: 你的一根羽毛让它露出真身。
lines.en: A feather revealed its presence.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地靠近你的脚边。
lines.en: It crept close to your feet silently.

lines.zh: 它在阴影中耐心等待机会。
lines.en: It waited in the shadows patiently.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠住了你的靴子。
lines.en: Its触须缠住了你的靴子. Its feelers wrapped around your boot.

lines.zh: 你的一次失误让它得手。
lines.en: A mistake gave it the chance.

lines.zh: 它的影子在地面上蠕动。
lines.en: Its shadow moved on the ground.
It撞上了你的肩膀. It bumped into your shoulder.
It滑行 over your backpack.

lines.zh: 它的触角勾住了你的背包。
lines.en: Its触角勾住了你的背包. Its feelers hooked your backpack.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞上了你的剑。
lines.en: Its body撞上了你的剑. Its body撞上了你的剑.
It躲进了你的兜帽里. It hid in your hood.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀碰到了你的头发。
lines.en: Its wings brushed against your hair.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴缠住了你的手。
lines.en: Its tail wrapped around your hand.

lines.zh: 它在你的衣服上留下了痕迹。
lines.en: It left a mark on your clothes.

lines.zh: 它的爪子划过了你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its claws划过了你的皮肤. Its claws scratched your skin.

lines.zh: 它的触角戳到了你的鼻子。
lines.en: Its触角戳到了你的鼻子. Its feelers poked your nose.
It found a mate.
Moonlit swamp — anyone for a mate?
They whispered in the shadows.
She and I side by side in moonlight.
They hid in the grass.

lines.zh: 它们在夜晚的沼泽中游荡。
lines.en: They roamed the swamp at night.

lines.zh: 它们在黑暗中互相寻找。
lines.en: They sought each other in the dark.
They played in the mud.
They snuggled to keep warm.
They whispered at night.

lines.zh: 阴影中闪现，偷走你的鞋子！
lines.en: Flickers in the shadows, stealing your shoes!

lines.zh: 悄悄接近，拿走你的背包！
lines.en: Creeps close, taking your backpack!
Hey, that hat is mine!
I need this coat!

lines.zh: 你的镐子是我的战利品！
lines.en: Your pickaxe is my trophy!
The sword is mine!
Steal your food!
Stop sharpening your knife!
Treasure in the shadows!
Take your leather boots!

lines.zh: 玩家进入视野，我可以行动了！
lines.en: Player in sight, I can move!
Sunlight, he must be wary!
Creeping in shadows, slowly approaching!
Target locked, ready to act!
He doesn't notice me, good!
Get close, my chance is here!
He's approaching, good!

lines.zh: 他进入了阴影，可以行动！
lines.en: He entered the shadow, act now!
He turned, danger!
Under the sun, cannot attack!

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着鼓鼓的袋子。
lines.en: A fat pouch hangs at your waist.
I fix on the pickaxe at your back.

lines.zh: 沼泽起雾了，正好掩护我。
lines.en: The swamp fog rises, just right to cover me.

lines.zh: 你蹲下系鞋带，机会来了。
lines.en: You crouch to tie a lace. There is my chance.

lines.zh: 你放下了火把，我看得更清。
lines.en: You set the torch down; I see better now.

lines.zh: 这个背包看起来能装不少。
lines.en: That pack looks like it holds plenty.
The prey in the shadows is mine!
He's approaching, I'm targeting!

lines.zh: 太阳出来了，我先躲一躲。
lines.en: The sun's out; I must hide.
Don't let the sun hit me!

lines.zh: 阴影中的秘密，我的藏身之处！
lines.en: Shadows, my hiding place!
My target, your possessions!

lines.zh: 阴影中的智慧，我的策略！
lines.en: Shadows, my strategy!
Sunlight, must hide!
Approach the shadow, don't be seen!
Sunlight, only invisibility!

lines.zh: 我先偷你左腰那个口袋。
lines.en: I will take the left pouch first.

lines.zh: 你的注意力在别处，很好。
lines.en: Your attention is elsewhere. Good.
In the mud I wait for your back.
The wind is fading your footprints.

lines.zh: 螯肢悬在半空，不发出声音。
lines.en: My pincers hang in the air, silent.
I only wait for a cloud to hide the sun.

lines.zh: 你的影子正好铺到我脚下。
lines.en: Your shadow reaches my feet perfectly.
I hold my breath and press into the mud.
The swamp water drowns my noise.
One step closer and I can act.

lines.zh: 它敏捷地掠过，你只闻其声不见其影。
lines.en: It darts by, heard but not seen.

lines.zh: 阴影中的低语，黑暗中的恐惧。
lines.en: Whispers from the shadows, fear in the dark.

lines.zh: 无声的偷袭，阴影中的幽灵。
lines.en: Silent assault, ghost in the shadows.

lines.zh: 阴影的馈赠，被夺走的珍宝。
lines.en: Shadow’s gift, stolen treasure.

lines.zh: 它在你身后悄悄接近，不留下痕迹。
lines.en: It sneaks up behind you, leaving no trace.

lines.zh: 阴影中飘动的黑影，悄悄接近。
lines.en: Black shadow flutters in the shadows, sneaking close.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的阴影，无声的掠夺者。
lines.en: Shadow in the darkness, silent raider.

lines.zh: 它在你不知情时悄然而至，带走你的心爱之物。
lines.en: It comes without notice, taking your treasured items.

lines.zh: 它从阴影中掠过，带走你的宝藏。
lines.en: It glides from the shadows, taking your treasure.

lines.zh: 阴影中的潜行者，无声地夺取。
lines.en: Shadow’s stealthy hunter, silently takes what it wants
Your pocket is empty and you have not noticed.
I have taken every one of your arrows.
One hook and the torch goes out in my grip.
I have cut your bootlaces.

lines.zh: 你的地图现在在我怀里。
lines.en: Your map is against my chest now.

lines.zh: 螯肢夹走你最后一块面包。
lines.en: My pincers pinch away your last loaf.

lines.zh: 我顺走了你的备用火把。
lines.en: I made off with your spare torch.

lines.zh: 护腕松了，我抽走了扣带。
lines.en: Your bracer loosens; I pulled the strap.
Your seed pouch feels much lighter.

lines.zh: 一转身，我已经在你身后了。
lines.en: You turn, and I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，阴影中的低语。
lines.en: Night falls, whispers in the shadows.

lines.zh: 阴影中的幽灵悄然降临。
lines.en: Ghostly shadows descend silently.
Dark messenger from the marshes.

lines.zh: 沼泽的夜晚，阴影的使者。
lines.en: Marsh’s night, shadow’s messenger.

lines.zh: 阴影中的低语，黑暗的召唤。
lines.en: Whispers in the shadows, dark summons.

lines.zh: 夜色笼罩，阴影中的低语。
lines.en: Night’s cloak, whispers in the shadows.

lines.zh: 沼泽的阴影，黑暗的使者。
lines.en: Marsh’s shadows, dark messenger.

lines.zh: 阴影中的幽灵，沼泽的夜晚。
lines.en: Ghostly shadows, marsh’s night.

lines.zh: 黑暗降临，阴影中的低语。
lines.en: Darkness falls, whispers in the shadows.

lines.zh: 夜晚降临，阴影中的低语。
lines.en: Night’s approach, whispers in the shadows
In the night fog, my shape appears.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面起了一层褶皱。
lines.en: A wrinkle crosses the swamp water.
Alp is consumed by fire.

lines.zh: 阿尔普从高处摔了下来。
lines.en: Alp falls from high up.
Alp drowns in water.

lines.zh: 阿尔普被爆炸震得支离破碎。
lines.en: Alp is shattered by the explosion.
Alp is hit by an arrow.
Alp is hit by magic.
Alp collapses from starvation.
Alp is struck by lightning.
Alp vanishes into the void.
